Package neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.viscosity

Class CO2ViscosityMethod

java.lang.Object
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.PhysicalPropertyMethod
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.CommonPhysicalPropertyMethod
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.viscosity.Viscosity
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.viscosity.CO2ViscosityMethod
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, ViscosityInterface, PhysicalPropertyMethodInterface
public class CO2ViscosityMethod extends Viscosity
Pure-CO2 background viscosity of Laesecke and Muzny, JPCRD 46, 013107 (2017). Includes the dilute, linear-in-density Rainwater-Friend, and residual contributions in equations 4-9. The critical enhancement is not included. Table 6 of the paper specifies check values for exactly this background correlation. NIST IR 8608 (2026), section 11, retains the 2017 viscosity formulation as the reference. Inputs are temperature in K and mass density in kg/m3; viscosity is in Pa s. The background API accepts 100-2000 K and nonnegative density. Callers must separately establish a physical fluid state inside the paper's gas or compressed-fluid range; mathematical input checks do not enforce the melting curve. The dilute-only API additionally permits the paper's documented extrapolation to 10000 K.
